summary: EUDA Health Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026, disclosing a press release about a non-binding memorandum of understanding (MOU) signed July 15, 2026, with GO POSB Organoids Pte Ltd and Shenzhen Innovation Immunotechnology Co., Ltd. The collaboration aims to develop and commercialize iPSC-based cell therapies for oncology and wellness. EUDA will fund and facilitate commercialization; no financial terms, share prices, or vote requirements are stated. This is a business development announcement, not a special situation. What to watch: whether definitive agreements and regulatory approvals materialize.
